description: Website for a local gas station
title: Mendez Fuel
longDescription: Website for a local gas station. Includes potential and plans for online ordering, draft beer live tap updates. Uses database to fill menu and options. Multi-locations with google maps embeds.

title: SlickFunnel
longDescription: I started SlickFunnel to give small-business owners a more human kind of help with their online presence: someone to talk things through with, make a clear plan, and take care of the details together. I work locally in South Florida and remotely with businesses everywhere.

title: Surveys
longDescription: Various surveys populated by a Supabase database. Form handling and pattern validation included. Sends responses back to the database and tracks users and sumbit counts.

description: Website and portal for cleaning company
title: White Glove Ward
longDescription: Booking with internal database, payments with stripe, and price calculations done back-end serverless functions.

description: create and preview react animations of 3D models
title: 3D Anim Maker
longDescription: A web-based tool for creating and previewing animations of 3D models. Uses phases of rotation, scale, and position. always returns to original position at the end. Uses three.js and react 3 fiber.
